checks.explanation: A handful of other founder/personality-driven public listings have occurred since (various SPAC and meme-adjacent listings), but no clear wave of DJT-style purely goodwill-valued celebrity IPOs has become a defining market trend through 2026.
Trump Media & Technology Group (DJT) stock fell dramatically from its early 2024 highs, losing the large majority of its value for investors who bought around this period through 2025-2026.
DJT shares declined sharply in the years following this episode, consistent with the prediction that buyers would lose a large portion of their investment.
Democratic-aligned lawyers did mount extensive legal challenges seeking to remove the RFK Jr.-Shanahan ticket from ballots in numerous swing states during the 2024 cycle.

RFK Jr. suspended his campaign and endorsed Trump in August 2024, and while he remained on some state ballots, his final vote share in swing states was well under a full couple of percentage points in most cases, making the precise magnitude of vote-siphoning hard to confirm as predicted.
This is a year-2100 population projection that cannot be verified with current data.

The US fiscal status quo of high spending and rising debt has indeed persisted without a sudden collapse through 2026, though rising debt-service costs and periodic bond-market stress (e.g., 2025 Treasury yield spikes) suggest growing strain rather than a fully comfortable status quo.

US federal interest expense has continued to climb well past $1 trillion annually through 2024-2026 as debt refinances at higher rates, and entitlement spending has continued to grow with demographic trends.
Chocolate manufacturers did respond to the 2024 cocoa price spike with smaller bar sizes and higher prices ('shrinkflation'), a widely reported trend through 2024.

The All-In Podcast's YouTube channel has grown substantially since 2024 and has held various live events and milestones, but a documented 'million subscriber party' matching this exact description is not clearly confirmed in available sources.
